outcome: Prevalence of VTE risk factors among postpartum women
cohort: 21,019 postpartum women in the Rotunda Hospital, Dublin, Ireland, representing over 90% of all women giving birth at the institution over a 3-year period (January 2015 - December 2017)
finding: Over three-quarters of postpartum women had at least one VTE risk factor, with the most common being overweight/obesity, age ≥35, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was one of the most common VTE risk factors, present in 32% of the cohort.
